learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to develop process engineering apparatus suitable for use and design them in compliance with guidelines, to integrate them into overall systems.
Students are able to evaluate process engineering apparatus and systems for environmentally friendly operation, to integrate ecological aspects into apparatus and system planning.

syllabus_topics: Independent development of an exemplary process in group work
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam.
